DISCLAIMER

- Optional external AI / TTS / STT provider support

Microphone usage is optional. The mod will ask for permission before using microphone input. If you select No, microphone input will remain disabled.

External AI features are optional and are not required to play the mod. By default, the mod can run using its built-in local behavior systems and packaged voice lines. If players choose to enable external providers, they must configure their own API keys.

THE MOD CAN TALK TO YOU IN THE CHAT AND HAVE VOICE

SETUP

Required:
Optional:
- External LLM provider for advanced conversations
- External TTS provider for generated voice
- External STT provider for microphone transcription

Supported optional LLM providers:
- OpenAI-compatible APIs
- Gemini
- Groq
- Ollama
- Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints

Supported optional TTS providers:
- Packaged local voice lines
- FishAudio
- Groq TTS
- OpenAI-compatible TTS

Supported optional STT providers:
- OpenAI Whisper-compatible transcription
- Groq Whisper-compatible transcription
- Custom compatible endpoints

HOW TO CONFIGURE AI FEATURES

In-game, use:

/falsityconfig

The config menu lets you set:
- External LLM on/off
- LLM provid

REQUIRES GECKOLIB

 

Meet Falsity your AI companion! 

Your companion who appears in your world with a simple goal: to help you! Over time this intelligent presence you share your Minecraft world with starts to remember, learn and sometimes make you wonder whether you're really alone...

DISCLAIMER this mod can talk to you and interact with the player.

At first, FALSITY feels like a helpful friend, but can you trust him?... He talks with a fully voiced AI system that remembers past events, recognizes your home and notices changes in your world. He even reacts differently depending on how you treat him!

He will remember your conversations, explore your world, and slowly develops his own personality over time. The more time you spend together, the more he learns about you, your habits, your builds, and the places you visit.

But as the days pass... strange things begin to happen.

Late at night, FALSITY may become distracted and stare at distant places. Sometimes he talks about things he shouldn't know. Sometimes he notices something watching from the darkness.

And sometimes... he isn't the only thing out there.

As the story unfolds, mysterious anomaly events begin appearing around your world.

concept of falsity in https://www.tiktok.com/@thefalsity

 

 

 

  • Fully voiced AI companion
  • Long-term memory system
  • English support
  • Dynamic personality development
  • Facial expressions
  • World observation and memory
  • House recognition system
  • Multiplayer support
  • Anomaly events and encounters
  • Dynamic chase system
  • Survival-friendly integration

Coded by: PKFL

Tester, contributor, and ideas Giox23yt

This is a new concept based on Falsity from  xqree and SirCloaked
